simple.meaning: קְרֵב (qᵉrêb) is a Hebrew action word meaning “approach, come (near, nigh), draw near.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 9 times in Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 6:10. The surrounding contexts include family line, offering, sacrifice, altar, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קְרֵב (H7127) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קְרֵב (qᵉrêb) / H7127 is traced through Ezra 6:10, Ezra 6:17, Ezra 7:17, Daniel 3:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: that they may offer sacrifices of pleasant aroma to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.

majorEvents.label: Offering
majorEvents.evidenceText: They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

timeline.evidenceText: that they may offer sacrifices of pleasant aroma to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.

They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

therefore you shall with all diligence buy with this money bulls, rams, lambs, with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, and shall offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and brought accusation against the Jews.
Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace. He spoke and said, “Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, you servants of the Most High God, come out, and come here!”

Then they answered and said before the king, “That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, doesn’t respect you, O king, nor the decree that you have signed, but makes his petition three times a day.”
Then Daniel said to the king, “O king, live forever!
“I saw in the night visions, and behold, there came with the clouds of the sky one like a son of man, and he came even to the ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.
I came near to one of those who stood by, and asked him the truth concerning all this.
